source_scope_note: Source describes process electromigration qualification estimates, not a probability established for this implementation. SG13RH20years/125C parenthetical is not applied to SG13G2.

engineering_screen.basis: Prospectively chosen design headroom below the pinned table, to expose bottlenecks and reserve nominal margin. This is an engineering target, NOT a foundry derating rule or proof covering temperature, lifetime, current crowding or unequal sharing.
rules: Use legal geometry, actual minimum width and every stack level; an upper array does not remove a lower single-cut bottleneck.
Report branch total, per-cut allocation assumptions, and both worst-single-cut and equal-sharing diagnostic utilizations separately.
Unknown branch current, current sharing, local temperature or applicable waveform/lifetime conditions cannot produce a qualified pass.
Compute DC, relevant RMS and sampled absolute peak separately. This table does not establish a pulse duty-cycle or peak-current relaxation rule; a peak screen is only conditional.
One-cut-unavailable connectivity and remaining equal-sharing margin are robustness diagnostics, not manufacturing-yield qualification.
No105C-to125C extrapolation or use of the separate SG13RH lifetime note. Obtain applicable bounds before claiming supported-hot lifetime compliance.
